title: 4xx client errors (esp. 404)
why_it_matters: Broken pages; wasted crawl; bad UX
recommended_fix: Fix or 301-redirect; update internal links.

title: Site not on HTTPS
recommended_fix: Migrate to HTTPS.

title: TTFB slow (>~0.8s)
recommended_fix: Investigate server performance or caching.

title: Render-blocking CSS/JS
recommended_fix: Add async/defer to scripts, inline critical CSS.

title: Tap targets too small / too close
recommended_fix: Make tap targets at least 44x44px with adequate spacing.

title: Interactive element missing accessible name/label
why_it_matters: Fails agentic a11y tree + screen readers
recommended_fix: Provide text content or aria-label for interactive elements.

title: Missing author + freshness signals (E-E-A-T for GEO)
recommended_fix: Add author and publish/modify date signals.

title: Missing/weak entity + Organization/Website schema
why_it_matters: AI can't confirm entity for citation
recommended_fix: Add Organization or Website structured data.

title: Google-Agent / Google-Extended handling not set intentionally
recommended_fix: Explicitly allow or block Google-Extended.

title: No first-party structured facts (pricing, FAQ, policies) exposed
recommended_fix: Add FAQPage, Product, or pricing schema.

title: Accessibility tree fails agent-centric names/labels
why_it_matters: Agents can't identify interactive elements (fails agentic audit)
recommended_fix: Provide text content or aria-label for interactive elements.

title: Missing/duplicate GA4 or GTM tags
recommended_fix: Install GA4 or GTM.

title: HTTP → HTTPS redirect missing
recommended_fix: 301-redirect all HTTP to HTTPS.

title: Meta description too thin for AI
why_it_matters: Little context for AI assistants and searchers
recommended_fix: Expand it into a detailed summary that names the key products, services and topics on the page, so AI and searchers understand it.

title: Missing/duplicate publish + modified dates
recommended_fix: Expose publish and modified dates in markup.

title: Unminified CSS/JS
recommended_fix: Minify CSS/JS (e.g. a WP caching/optimization plugin).

title: Forms lack WebMCP declarative annotations
why_it_matters: Agents parse pixels instead of calling tools
recommended_fix: Add WebMCP declarative data attributes to forms.

title: Key flows (checkout/booking/contact) not agent-completable
recommended_fix: Annotate key-flow forms (checkout/booking/contact) for agent completion.

title: No compression (gzip/brotli)
recommended_fix: Enable gzip/brotli compression on the server/CDN.

title: Auto-generated image sizes bloating media / no WebP
recommended_fix: Serve images as WebP/AVIF (e.g. a WP image-optimization plugin).

title: Missing GSC verification
recommended_fix: Verify the site in Search Console (meta tag or DNS).

title: Title too long (>~60 chars / ~575px)
recommended_fix: Shorten to avoid truncation.

evidence.title: Children's Dentistry, Fissure Sealants, Fluoride Varnish and First Dental Visits for Babies, Toddlers and Teenagers | Harbourline Dental Studio Bristol

title: Title too short (<~30 chars)
recommended_fix: Expand the title to use available space.

title: Multiple `<title>` elements
recommended_fix: Keep a single title tag.

title: CLS > 0.1 (good) / > 0.25 (poor)
recommended_fix: Set width/height on media, reserve space for late content.

title: **Post-load CLS** (menus/late banners shift after settle)
why_it_matters: Agent clicks stale coordinates → task fails; lab CLS misses this
recommended_fix: Stabilize late-shifting menus/banners after load settles.

title: Missing document language attribute
recommended_fix: Add lang attribute to <html> tag.

title: Thin content (low word count / low main-content ratio)
why_it_matters: Weak page, may not rank/be cited
recommended_fix: Expand with useful, unique content or consolidate.

title: Render blocked by JS error / failed resource
recommended_fix: Fix the JavaScript errors preventing a clean render.

title: Missing meta description
recommended_fix: Add a detailed description (about 120 to 320 characters) that summarizes the page and names its key products, services and topics, so search engines and AI assistants understand it.

title: Missing/incorrect OG + Twitter Card tags
recommended_fix: Add OG + Twitter Card tags for rich previews.

title: Orphan URL (in sitemap/GSC but no internal inlinks)
why_it_matters: Not discoverable via crawl; wasted page
recommended_fix: Add internal links from relevant pages.

title: Missing H1
recommended_fix: Add one descriptive H1.

title: Orphan pages (no internal inlinks)
recommended_fix: Add relevant internal links pointing to this page.

title: Primary content client-side rendered (AI bots don't run JS)
recommended_fix: Implement server-side rendering or dynamic rendering for bots.

title: Incomplete schema (missing recommended properties)
why_it_matters: Missing recommended schema properties reduce rich-result eligibility.
recommended_fix: Add the missing properties to the structured-data block(s).

title: Missing answer-capsule structure (direct answer before context)
recommended_fix: Open with a concise direct-answer paragraph before the first heading.

title: Missing security headers (CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy)
recommended_fix: Add the missing security headers (CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy).

title: Content interactive but hidden from a11y tree
recommended_fix: Remove aria-hidden from interactive elements or make them non-interactive.

title: Interactive-but-invisible-to-a11y-tree elements
recommended_fix: Remove aria-hidden from interactive elements or make them non-interactive.

title: Nofollowed internal links to important pages
recommended_fix: Remove nofollow from internal links you want crawled.

title: Internal `nofollow` sculpting (unintended)
recommended_fix: Remove nofollow from internal links you want crawled.

title: Tag/author/date archives indexed & thin/duplicate
recommended_fix: Noindex archives if not needed.

title: Broken/empty anchor text
recommended_fix: Add descriptive anchor text (or alt text if image links).

title: LCP > 2.5s (good) / > 4s (poor)
why_it_matters: Slow perceived load; Core Web Vital
recommended_fix: Optimize the LCP element (image, hosting, render-blocking).

title: Long render/hydration time
recommended_fix: Reduce hydration/render time (code-split, defer non-critical JS).

title: Canonical uses relative / protocol-relative / non-absolute URL
recommended_fix: Use an absolute canonical inside <head>.

title: Multiple meta descriptions
recommended_fix: Ensure only one meta description exists.

title: X-Robots-Tag `noindex` (header)
recommended_fix: Remove noindex from the X-Robots-Tag response header.

title: Non-indexable page receiving internal links
why_it_matters: Link equity leaking to dead ends
recommended_fix: Remove internal links to non-indexable pages, or make the page indexable.

title: Server/software version leakage in headers
recommended_fix: Strip version numbers from Server / X-Powered-By headers.

title: Invalid/unsupported ARIA attributes
recommended_fix: Use valid ARIA attributes.

title: Multiple conflicting canonicals on one page
recommended_fix: Keep exactly one canonical.

title: Pages with only 1 internal inlink
recommended_fix: Add contextual internal links from related pages.

title: Missing/duplicate canonical from theme + plugin both emitting
recommended_fix: Fix theme to not output canonical.

title: Excessive DOM size (agentic + perf)
recommended_fix: Reduce DOM complexity.

title: Hard-to-read content (low readability)
why_it_matters: Dense prose lowers comprehension and AI passage extraction.
recommended_fix: Shorten sentences, simplify wording; target a Flesch score of 60+ (plain English).

title: Meta robots `nosnippet`/`noarchive`/`max-snippet` unexpected
recommended_fix: Confirm you intend to suppress snippet/preview features.

title: Non-self-referential canonical (unintended)
why_it_matters: Page canonicalizes away, may drop from index
recommended_fix: Point the canonical at this URL unless consolidation is intended.

title: Internal links to non-canonical / redirected URLs
recommended_fix: Link directly to the canonical URL.

title: Multiple H1s
recommended_fix: Prefer a single H1 (context-dependent).

title: Underscores instead of hyphens as word separators
recommended_fix: Use hyphens.

title: Form field without associated label
recommended_fix: Add <label> elements or aria-label attributes to form fields.

title: Broken heading order (skips H2→H4)
recommended_fix: Keep heading hierarchy sequential.

title: Lorem ipsum / placeholder text detected
recommended_fix: Replace placeholder text before launch.

title: Missing page title
recommended_fix: Add a unique, descriptive title tag.

title: Missing 'view-all' or crawl path for deep lists
recommended_fix: Offer a 'view all' page or a crawl path to deep list items.

title: Uppercase characters in URL
recommended_fix: Use lowercase URLs.

title: Missing viewport meta
recommended_fix: Add <meta name=viewport content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1'>.

title: Missing/incorrect viewport meta
recommended_fix: Add a <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> tag to the <head>.

title: Meta robots `noindex` on key page
recommended_fix: Remove noindex if this page should rank.

title: Missing canonical
why_it_matters: No consolidation signal on dup-prone URLs
recommended_fix: Add a self-referential canonical.

title: No breadcrumb / weak hierarchical linking
recommended_fix: Add breadcrumbs with BreadcrumbList schema.

title: Missing skip links / landmark regions
recommended_fix: Add semantic landmark regions like <main> and <nav>.

title: `llms.txt` present but missing H1 / too short / no links
recommended_fix: Ensure llms.txt has a primary H1, adequate content, and links.

title: Favicon missing / broken
recommended_fix: Add a favicon.

title: Meta-refresh / JS redirect
recommended_fix: Replace with a server-side 301.

title: Canonical changed/added/removed by JS (response vs render)
recommended_fix: Emit the final canonical in server HTML.

title: Title/description created or modified by JS only
recommended_fix: Render metadata server-side.

title: Title/meta/canonical/robots differ response vs render
recommended_fix: Ensure title, meta description, robots, and canonical tags match exactly between raw and rendered HTML.

title.raw: Summer Whitening Offer | Harbourline Dental Studio
title.rendered: Professional Teeth Whitening | Harbourline Dental Studio

meta_description.raw: Our summer whitening offer has moved to the teeth whitening page.
meta_description.rendered: Dentist-supervised home whitening with custom trays. Safe peroxide strengths, a shade check before and after, and advice on keeping results.

title: Dynamic JS tool/element registration timing issues
recommended_fix: Register interactive elements/links server-side or early in load.

title: Soft 404 (200 status, "not found" content)
recommended_fix: Return a real 404/410, or restore/replace the content.

evidence.title: Page not found | Harbourline Dental Studio

title: Paginated page 2+ canonicalized to page 1 (anti-pattern)
recommended_fix: Use self-referential canonicals on paginated URLs.

title: Page 2+ canonicalized to page 1
recommended_fix: Self-canonicalize paginated pages.

title: Redirect to 4xx/5xx (broken redirect target)
recommended_fix: Redirect to a working 200 URL.

title: 5xx server errors
why_it_matters: Server failing; severe if on key/many pages
recommended_fix: Investigate server logs; restore 200.

evidence.title: healthy eating for healthy teeth | harbourline dental studio

evidence.meta_desc: common causes of bad breath and dry mouth, and practical steps that help. when to see a dentist or a doctor.

title: AI training crawlers blocked in robots.txt (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Google-Extended)
why_it_matters: Excluded from AI training/knowledge (a *choice*, but flag it)

title: AI **search** crawlers blocked (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot)
why_it_matters: Excluded from AI search answers → visibility loss

title: Broken internal links (→4xx/5xx)
recommended_fix: Fix or remove internal links pointing to 4xx/5xx pages.

title: Optional `llms-full.txt` absent (large-doc sites)
recommended_fix: Consider adding llms-full.txt for large-doc sites.

title: Canonical to non-indexable (noindex) URL
recommended_fix: Point the canonical at an indexable URL.
